[LINK=UNITCOMBAT_ADEPT]Arcane units[\\LINK] are to be gifted with Affinity for [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_DEATH_ARAWN]Death[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_DEATH]Undeath[\\LINK]. (Note that any Death promotion blocks access to all Undeath promotions, and vice versa. ) Affinity promotions not only increase the unit's strength based on how much mana you control, but let it learn more powerful versions of the spells in the sphere for free, without spending any xp to level up, so long as it has the proper Channeling promotions. [PARAGRAPH:2]Those who channel Death mana are divided into two factions, who utterly despise each other. The larger faction are practitioners of Undeath magic who pervert the sphere to create abominations despised by Arawn. The minority who honor Arawn and try to use Death magic ethically are often persecuted and falsely condemned for heinous crimes committed by Necromancers, as most denizens of Erebus do not know or care to learn the difference between the two groups. [PARAGRAPH]The [LINK=PROMOTION_DEATH_ARAWN1]Death I[\\LINK] promotion can only be purchased by units who follow the [LINK=RELIGION_ETERNAL_CABAL]Eternal Cabal[\\LINK] religion, but those who are given that randomly may purchase [LINK=PROMOTION_DEATH_ARAWN2]Death II[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_DEATH_ARAWN3]Death III[\\LINK] regardless of religion. If a unit without the [LINK=RELIGION_ETERNAL_CABAL]Eternal Cabal[\\LINK] religion has an evil alignment due to another religion or another evil promotion, its Death promotions will be changed to Undeath automatically. [PARAGRAPH]Death mana normally has a negative effect on Health, but the [LINK=RELIGION_ETERNAL_CABAL]Eternal Cabal[\\LINK]'s holy shrine the [LINK=BUILDING_TOMB_OF_ARAWN]Tomb of Arawn[\\LINK] causes Death mana to improve health. It also removed Undeath promotions from units in the city and makes the city impassible to undead units. It requires Death mana to build, provides more Death mana, and cannot be built by evil civs who would use that death mana for Undeath magic. [PARAGRAPH]The Sidar can never purchase Undeath promotions or use Necromancy spells, so they can build the Tomb of Arawn regardless of alignment. They can also force its construction with their [LINK=UNIT_SHADE]Shades[\\LINK], or build the religion's temples the [LINK=BUILDING_RELIQUARY]Reliquary[\\LINK] with their [LINK=UNIT_SHADE]Shades[\\LINK] or [LINK=UNIT_GHOST]Ghosts[\\LINK]. Instead of the normal [LINK=BUILDING_SOUL_FORGE]Soul Forge[\\LINK] they can build the [LINK=BUILDING_SOUL_SHROUD]Soul Shroud[\\LINK], which removes immortality from any rival units, blocks the casting of any Undeath spells, and kills any undead units that enters their territory. [PARAGRAPH:2]The precept of Death is about surrender and resignation, intended to balance the perseverance of the precept of Life. It is the rest for which a soul longs once it is weary of the world. It allows the old to get out of the way and to make room for the new. During the first few generations of man, death was rare and almost always welcome. The widespread fear of death today is a sign of the world's corruption. [PARAGRAPH]Most Death magic in Erebus is actually Undeath magic, a terrible deviation from what the Death sphere is supposed to represent. The [LINK=PROMOTION_UNDEAD]Undead[\\LINK] are created by magic that binds the souls of the departed to the world of the living. This is extremely unhealthy both for them and the world around them, leading to much corruption. [PARAGRAPH]Arawn has never been a very active god. He tried to stay out of the Godswar, although the mortal warlord Barbatos tried to take the war to him and invade his vault. As punishment he barred Barbatos from ever entering the Netherworld, so he would be forever dying but never find rest. He treated Maoliosa and the Silkies much the same. When this caused a proliferation of necromancers creating ever worse abominations, he withdrew himself even further so as to limit their access to death mana rather than taking them out of the world of the living. [PARAGRAPH]The Unblemished teach that Arawn gifted the power of Life to Sucellus out of recognition of their god's superior virtue, but this is a lie. When embodying both Life and Death, Arawn had to die and rise again each year on Samhain. Sucellus used the opportunity of Arawn's death to steal the Font of Life, allowing him to raise himself as the new God of Life while leaving Arawn languishing as an almost powerless ghost of his former self. Such decisions angered many of his servants, who have abandoned him to follow Basium or Laroth. A few of his loyal angels care enough to help the archangel Gyra defend the realm and carry out the duties that should be his. [PARAGRAPH]Arawn was always very dour, but generally benevolent. He prefers to shelter the souls of the departed, not manipulate them into serving his purposes. The Compact demands that Arawn judge spirits of the dead to determine which god has the strongest claim, and then and pass them on their vaults to be made into angels or demons. He has been very lax in this duty. He prefers to leave the spirits to wander in the vast dreamland of his Netherworld, where the subconscious of each mortal soul fashions the sort of afterlife it believes itself to deserve. This is usually more fair than any reward or punishment any god could devise, but there are a few strong souls whose lucid dreams grant them undeserved power. The archmage Laroth is building an army of such souls in the hope of usurping the precept and becoming a god.

[PARAGRAPH:2]引导死亡能量者分为两派，彼此深恶痛绝。较大的一派是不死魔法的修习者，他们扭曲这一领域，制造出为阿劳恩所憎恶的畸物。少数尊崇阿劳恩、力求合乎伦理地使用死亡魔法者，却常遭迫害，被诬以死灵法师所犯的滔天罪行——因为埃瑞布斯的多数居民既不了解、也不屑于分辨这两类人的区别。 [PARAGRAPH] [LINK=PROMOTION_DEATH_ARAWN1]死亡 I[\\LINK] 晋升只能由信奉 [LINK=RELIGION_ETERNAL_CABAL]永恒秘党[\\LINK] 宗教的单位购买，但随机获得该晋升者，则不论信仰皆可购买 [LINK=PROMOTION_DEATH_ARAWN2]死亡 II[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_DEATH_ARAWN3]死亡 III[\\LINK] 。若某单位并不信奉 [LINK=RELIGION_ETERNAL_CABAL]永恒秘党[\\LINK] 宗教，却因另一宗教或另一邪恶晋升而具有邪恶阵营，则其死亡晋升会自动变为不死晋升。 [PARAGRAPH]死亡能量通常对健康有负面影响，但 [LINK=RELIGION_ETERNAL_CABAL]永恒秘党[\\LINK]的圣祠—— [LINK=BUILDING_TOMB_OF_ARAWN]阿劳恩之墓[\\LINK] ——会使死亡能量转而增益健康。它还会移除城中单位的不死晋升，并使不死单位无法通行该城。建造它需要死亡能量，它也会提供更多死亡能量，且不能由那些会将死亡能量用于不死魔法的邪恶文明建造。 [PARAGRAPH]希达永生者永远无法购买不死晋升，也无法使用死灵法术，因此不论阵营都可建造阿劳恩之墓。他们还可用 [LINK=UNIT_SHADE]暗影[\\LINK]强行建造它，或用 [LINK=BUILDING_RELIQUARY]圣物阁[\\LINK] 建造该宗教的神殿—— [LINK=UNIT_SHADE]暗影[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=UNIT_GHOST]幽灵[\\LINK]。此外，他们不必建造寻常的 [LINK=BUILDING_SOUL_FORGE]灵魂熔炉[\\LINK] ，而可建造 [LINK=BUILDING_SOUL_SHROUD]灵魂裹尸布[\\LINK]——它会剥夺任何敌方单位的不朽，封锁一切不死法术的施放，并杀死任何进入其领土的不死单位。 [PARAGRAPH:2]死亡的法理关乎顺从与放下，意在平衡生命法理中的坚忍。它是灵魂厌倦尘世后所渴望的安息。它让旧者让位，为新者腾出空间。在人类最初的几代里，死亡罕见，且几乎总受欢迎。今日对死亡的普遍恐惧，正是世界腐化的征兆。 [PARAGRAPH]埃瑞布斯的大多数死亡魔法其实是不死魔法，是对死亡领域本应代表之物的可怕背离。 [LINK=PROMOTION_UNDEAD]不死者[\\LINK] 是由将亡者灵魂束缚于生者世界的魔法所造。这对它们自身与周遭世界都极为有害，会招致大量腐化。 [PARAGRAPH]阿劳恩从来不是一位活跃的神。他力图置身于诸神之战之外，尽管凡人军阀巴巴托斯曾试图将战火引向他、入侵他的宝库。作为惩罚，他禁止巴巴托斯永世踏入冥界，使其永远垂死却永不得安息。他对莫利奥萨与海豹妖也如出一辙。当此举导致死灵法师泛滥、制造出愈发可怕的畸物时，他索性更加隐退，以此限制他们对死亡能量的取用，而非将他们逐出生者的世界。 [PARAGRAPH]纯洁教团宣称，阿劳恩是因认可苏切鲁斯之神更高的德行，才将生命之力赐予他，但这是谎言。当阿劳恩同时体现生与死时，他每年都须在萨温节死去、再复生。苏切鲁斯趁阿劳恩死去之机窃取了生命之泉，得以将自己扶立为新的生命之神，却任由阿劳恩沦为几乎毫无力量、形销骨立的幽魂。这类决定激怒了他的许多仆从，他们抛弃了他，转投巴希姆或拉罗斯。仅有少数忠诚的天使还在意，愿意协助大天使吉拉守卫这一国度，履行本应属于他的职责。 [PARAGRAPH]阿劳恩向来阴郁，但大体仁慈。他宁愿庇护亡者的灵魂，而非操纵它们为己所用。盟约要求阿劳恩审判亡者之灵，判定哪位神对其拥有最强的主张，再将其交往相应宝库，铸成天使或恶魔。他对这一职责极为懈怠。他宁愿任亡灵游荡于他冥界那片辽阔的梦境之中——在那里，每个凡人灵魂的潜意识会自行塑造出它认为自己应得的来世。这通常比任何神所能设计的赏罚都更为公道，但也有少数强大的灵魂，其清醒之梦会赐予它们不该得的力量。大魔法师拉罗斯正以此类灵魂缔造一支大军，图谋篡夺这一法理、跻身神位。

english: [TAB]Allows access to the Dimensional sphere spells:[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_ESCAPE]Escape[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_DIMENSIONAL1]Dimensional I[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_PLANAR_BINDING]Planar Binding[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_DIMENSIONAL2]Dimensional II[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_DOOR_OF_ETHER]Door of Ether[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_DIMENSIONAL3]Dimensional III[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_SUMMON_WARP_BUBBLE]Summon Warp Bubble[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_DIMENSIONAL]Dimensional Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING4]Channeling IV[\\LINK][PARAGRAPH:2]The more sources of this Mana you control, the more likely your [LINK=UNITCOMBAT_ADEPT]Arcane units[\\LINK] are to be gifted with [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_DIMENSIONAL]Affinity for this sphere[\\LINK]. That not only increases the unit's strength based on how much mana you control, but lets it learn more powerful versions of the spells in this sphere for free, without spending any xp to level up, so long as it has the proper Channeling promotions. Other units in the same stack as a unit with Dimensional Affinity may also cast [LINK=SPELL_ESCAPE_FACILITATED]Escape[\\LINK][PARAGRAPH]Dimensional promotions cause a summoner to keep a portion of its summons experience points when they die. [PARAGRAPH]This resource causes unhappiness and a diplomatic penalty with many leaders. It causes a diplomatic bonus with those evil leaders who wish to destroy the world. [PARAGRAPH]The effective supply of Dimensional Mana is greater for the [LINK=CIVILIZATION_SHEAIM]Sheaim[\\LINK] civilization. [PARAGRAPH:2]Dimensional is the sphere of relational identity. It was created to establish bonds between individuals, but since Ceridwen's fall has been more focused on breaking these bonds. Ceridwen leads us to value others only based on what they are to us, rather than appreciating them for who they really are. This leads to very unhealthy relationships, obsessions, and emotional pain. A master who defined himself by his position relative his servant will abuse the servant. He will fear loosing his position and never be able to turn their relationship into a friendship. A servant who obsesses over his own lowly estate will envy and despise his master rather than improving his own lot or enjoying life. A husband who is paranoid that his wife will be unfaithful will drive her away through his jealousy. [PARAGRAPH][LINK=RELIGION_COVEN]The Between[\\LINK] are the primary cult of Ceridwen. Its is a Coven of mostly masked [LINK=UNIT_MOBIUS_WITCH]sorceresses[\\LINK] who [LINK=SPELL_SEVER]Astral Project[\\LINK] to send their minds, souls, and sometimes bodies to explore other worlds and learn strange new forms of magic. The [LINK=UNIT_EMRY]Emrys[\\LINK] are a cult of Ceridwen that seeks to destroy the whole world. They travel through all lands seeking to recruit talented adepts to rebel against the restrictions of traditional mage guilds and come practice the dark arts among the [LINK=CIVILIZATION_SHEAIM]Sheaim[\\LINK]. [LINK=UNIT_CHAINBREAKER]The Chainbreakers[\\LINK] are a cult devoted to Ceridwen who actively try to liberate individuals from unjust social institutions such as slavery.
chinese: [TAB]开放次元领域法术：[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_ESCAPE]遁走[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_DIMENSIONAL1]次元 I[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_PLANAR_BINDING]位面束缚[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_DIMENSIONAL2]次元 II[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_DOOR_OF_ETHER]以太之门[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_DIMENSIONAL3]次元 III[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_SUMMON_WARP_BUBBLE]召唤扭曲气泡[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_DIMENSIONAL]次元亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING4]引导 IV[\\LINK][PARAGRAPH:2]你所控制的此种能量来源越多，你的 [LINK=UNITCOMBAT_ADEPT]秘法单位[\\LINK] 获赠 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_DIMENSIONAL]对该领域的亲和[\\LINK]的几率就越高。此亲和不仅会依据你控制的能量多寡提升该单位的力量，还能让它免费习得该领域更强大的法术版本，无需花费经验值升级——只要它具备相应的引导晋升即可。与拥有次元亲和的单位处于同一部队的其他单位，也可施放 [LINK=SPELL_ESCAPE_FACILITATED]遁走[\\LINK][PARAGRAPH]次元晋升能让召唤者在其召唤物死亡时，保留其部分经验值。 [PARAGRAPH]此资源会造成不满，并招致许多领袖的外交恶感。但它会赢得那些意欲毁灭世界的邪恶领袖的外交好感。 [PARAGRAPH]次元能量的有效供给，对 [LINK=CIVILIZATION_SHEAIM]塞安[\\LINK] 文明。 [PARAGRAPH:2]次元是关系性身份的领域。它被创造出来，本是为在个体之间建立纽带，但自瑟丽德温堕落以来，它更多地转向斩断这些纽带。瑟丽德温使我们仅凭他人于己的意义来衡量他们，而非欣赏他们真实的样子。这会导致极不健康的关系、执念与情感之痛。一个以自己相对仆从的地位来定义自身的主人，会虐待其仆从；他会惧怕失去地位，永远无法将这段关系化为友谊。一个执迷于自身卑微处境的仆从，会嫉妒并鄙视其主人，而非改善自身境遇或享受生活。一个偏执地认定妻子会不忠的丈夫，会以其猜忌将她逼走。 [PARAGRAPH][LINK=RELIGION_COVEN]界间之众[\\LINK] 是瑟丽德温的主要教团。这是一个女巫会，成员多为戴面具的 [LINK=UNIT_MOBIUS_WITCH]女巫[\\LINK] ，她们会 [LINK=SPELL_SEVER]星界投射[\\LINK] ，将自己的心智、灵魂、有时乃至肉体送往其他世界，探索并习得奇异的新型魔法。 [LINK=UNIT_EMRY]埃姆里斯众[\\LINK] 是瑟丽德温的一个教团，意图摧毁整个世界。他们游走各地，招募有天赋的术士，煽动其反抗传统法师公会的束缚，前来在 [LINK=CIVILIZATION_SHEAIM]塞安[\\LINK]。 [LINK=UNIT_CHAINBREAKER]断链者[\\LINK] 是献身于瑟丽德温的一个教团，积极致力于将个体从奴隶制等不公的社会制度中解放出来。

english: [TAB]Allows access to the Earth sphere spells:[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_DILIGENCE]Diligence[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_EARTH1]Earth I[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_EARTH]Earth Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING1]Channeling I[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_STONESKIN]Stoneskin[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_EARTH2]Earth II[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_EARTH]Earth Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING2]Channeling II[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_SUMMON_EARTH_ELEMENTAL]Summon Earth Elemental[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_EARTH3]Earth III[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_EARTH]Earth Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING3]Channeling III[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_EARTHQUAKE]Earthquake[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_EARTH]Earth Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING4]Channeling IV[\\LINK][PARAGRAPH:2]The more sources of this Mana you control, the more likely your [LINK=UNITCOMBAT_ADEPT]Arcane units[\\LINK] are to be gifted with [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_EARTH]Affinity for this sphere[\\LINK]. That not only increases the unit's strength based on how much mana you control, but lets it learn more powerful versions of the spells in this sphere for free, without spending any xp to level up, so long as it has the proper Channeling promotions. [PARAGRAPH]The effective supply of Earth Mana is greater for the [LINK=CIVILIZATION_KHAZAD]Khazad[\\LINK] civilization. It is increased for those following [LINK=RELIGION_RUNES_OF_KILMORPH]The Runes of Kilmorph[\\LINK], and decreased for those following [LINK=RELIGION_FOXMEN]The Foxmen[\\LINK] either as a State Religion or as the caster's personal faith. [PARAGRAPH:2]The sphere of Earth does not pertain merely to its physical manifestations, the elements of rocks and dirt that make up the ground beneath us. Deep down, it is about valuing the virtues of honest labor and the benefits it allows us to reap. Those who exemplify this sphere are often considered too stuffy and conservative, but they prefer to think of themselves as well grounded. Physical manifestations of this magic are however strengthened by contact with massive blocks of stone and weakened when standing on dirt or cut blocks. Practitioners may lose all affinity for this dominion if they aren't in contact with the earth at all. Being in a tree, on a horse, or simply held up in the air by someone else will negate their ability. But when in contact the practitioner can call on all aspects of the world to either imbue themselves with these aspects or transform the earth and stone around them.
chinese: [TAB]开放大地领域法术：[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_DILIGENCE]勤勉[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_EARTH1]大地 I[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_EARTH]大地亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING1]引导 I[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_STONESKIN]石肤[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_EARTH2]大地 II[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_EARTH]大地亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING2]引导 II[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_SUMMON_EARTH_ELEMENTAL]召唤地元素[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_EARTH3]大地 III[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_EARTH]大地亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING3]引导 III[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_EARTHQUAKE]地震[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_EARTH]大地亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING4]引导 IV[\\LINK][PARAGRAPH:2]你所控制的此种能量来源越多，你的 [LINK=UNITCOMBAT_ADEPT]秘法单位[\\LINK] 获赠 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_EARTH]对该领域的亲和[\\LINK]的几率就越高。此亲和不仅会依据你控制的能量多寡提升该单位的力量，还能让它免费习得该领域更强大的法术版本，无需花费经验值升级——只要它具备相应的引导晋升即可。 [PARAGRAPH]大地能量的有效供给，对 [LINK=CIVILIZATION_KHAZAD]卡扎德[\\LINK] 文明。对跟随 [LINK=RELIGION_RUNES_OF_KILMORPH]基尔莫芙符文[\\LINK]者增加，而对跟随 [LINK=RELIGION_FOXMEN]狐人众[\\LINK] （无论作为国教还是施法者个人信仰）者而言则如此。 [PARAGRAPH:2]大地的领域不只关乎其有形的显现——构成我们脚下地面的岩石与泥土。究其根本，它关乎珍视诚实劳作的德行，以及劳作让我们收获的益处。体现这一领域者常被视为过于古板守旧，但他们更愿把自己看作脚踏实地。不过，这类魔法的有形显现会因接触巨大的石块而增强，因立于泥土或经切凿的石块上而减弱。修习者若完全不与大地接触，便可能失去对这一领域的全部亲和。身处树上、骑在马背、或只是被他人托举于空中，都会抵消其能力。但一旦接触大地，修习者便能召唤世间万象的诸般属性，或以之充盈自身，或转化周遭的土石。

english: [TAB]Allows access to the Enchantment sphere spells:[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_ENCHANTED_BLADE]Enchanted Blade[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_ENCHANTMENT1]Enchantment I[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_ENCHANTMENT]Enchantment Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING1]Channeling I[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_EMPOWER_ENGINE]Empower Engine[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_ENCHANTMENT2]Enchantment II[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_ENCHANTMENT]Enchantment Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING2]Channeling II[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_CRAFT_ARTIFACT]Craft Artifact[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_ENCHANTMENT3]Enchantment III[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_ENCHANTMENT]Enchantment Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING3]Channeling III[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_CRAFT_AUTOMATON]Craft Automaton[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_ENCHANTMENT]Enchantment Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING4]Channeling IV[\\LINK][PARAGRAPH:2]The more sources of this Mana you control, the more likely your [LINK=UNITCOMBAT_ADEPT]Arcane units[\\LINK] are to be gifted with [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_ENCHANTMENT]Affinity for this sphere[\\LINK]. That not only increases the unit's strength based on how much mana you control, but lets it learn more powerful versions of the spells in this sphere for free, without spending any xp to level up, so long as it has the proper Channeling promotions. [PARAGRAPH]The effective supply of Enchantment Mana is greater for the [LINK=CIVILIZATION_LUCHUIRP]Luchuirp[\\LINK] civilization. It is increased for those following [LINK=RELIGION_RINGGIVER]The Ringgivers[\\LINK], and decreased for those following [LINK=RELIGION_COVEN]The Coven[\\LINK] either as a State Religion or as the caster's personal faith. [PARAGRAPH:2]The sphere of Enchantment is the opposite of the Dimensional sphere. It has to do with valuing the individual for his own individual virtues, regardless of his position in society. This leads to happier relationships. It is the sphere of improvement. The sphere leads us to make our natural strengths stronger. This dominion never works overtly. Instead the aspects of objects are enhanced by it. Without other dominions, only existing aspects can be heightened, a wall can be made stronger, a sword sharper. But with ties with fire a sword can be given a burning blade, or with darkness a charm can be made to hide the wearer. These spells take complex rituals and days, weeks, months or years to cast depending on their complexity. Practitioners of this dominion are typically collectors of obscure and varied objects. They can sense the affinity an object has for a dominion and they are quick to gather ones with a strong affinity because it makes enchanting them in that dominion much easier. A practitioner skilled in this dominion and death is likely to have a morbid collection of items strong with death affinity nearby, murderer's knives, gravedigger's shovel, pieces of gravestones, hangman's noose, etc. They occasionally find affinity for an item that they don't expect (a key with a strong affinity for mind magic) and can spend a lot of time trying to research the history of the object to find out why.
chinese: [TAB]开放附魔领域法术：[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_ENCHANTED_BLADE]附魔之刃[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_ENCHANTMENT1]附魔 I[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_ENCHANTMENT]附魔亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING1]引导 I[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_EMPOWER_ENGINE]强化机械[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_ENCHANTMENT2]附魔 II[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_ENCHANTMENT]附魔亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING2]引导 II[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_CRAFT_ARTIFACT]打造神器[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_ENCHANTMENT3]附魔 III[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_ENCHANTMENT]附魔亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING3]引导 III[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_CRAFT_AUTOMATON]打造自动机偶[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_ENCHANTMENT]附魔亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING4]引导 IV[\\LINK][PARAGRAPH:2]你所控制的此种能量来源越多，你的 [LINK=UNITCOMBAT_ADEPT]秘法单位[\\LINK] 获赠 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_ENCHANTMENT]对该领域的亲和[\\LINK]的几率就越高。此亲和不仅会依据你控制的能量多寡提升该单位的力量，还能让它免费习得该领域更强大的法术版本，无需花费经验值升级——只要它具备相应的引导晋升即可。 [PARAGRAPH]附魔能量的有效供给，对 [LINK=CIVILIZATION_LUCHUIRP]鲁崔尔普[\\LINK] 文明。对跟随 [LINK=RELIGION_RINGGIVER]授环者[\\LINK]者增加，而对跟随 [LINK=RELIGION_COVEN]女巫会[\\LINK] （无论作为国教还是施法者个人信仰）者而言则如此。 [PARAGRAPH:2]附魔的领域与次元领域正相反。它关乎因个体自身的德行来珍视个体，而不论其社会地位。这带来更幸福的关系。它是改良的领域，引导我们将自身天生的长处变得更强。这一支配从不公然施为，而是借它增强物件的固有属性。若无其他支配相辅，只能增强既有的属性——墙可更坚，剑可更利。但若与炎相联，剑可被赋予燃烧的锋刃；若与暗相联，护符可让佩戴者隐匿。这些法术需要繁复的仪式，视其复杂程度，施放耗时数日、数周、数月乃至数年。这一支配的修习者通常是冷僻杂物的收藏家。他们能感知物件对某一支配的亲和，并会迅速搜罗亲和强烈者，因为这会使在该支配下附魔它们容易得多。一位精通此支配与死亡的修习者，身边多半有一批阴森的、死亡亲和强烈的藏品：凶手的刀、掘墓人的铲、墓碑残片、绞刑的绳套，诸如此类。他们偶尔会在意想不到的物件上发现亲和（一把对精神魔法有强烈亲和的钥匙），并会花大量时间去考究该物的来历，探寻其中缘由。

english: [TAB]Allows access to the Entropy sphere spells:[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_RUST]Rust[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_ENTROPY1]Entropy I[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_ENTROPY]Entropy Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING1]Channeling I[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_WITHER]Wither[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_ENTROPY2]Entropy II[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_ENTROPY]Entropy Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING2]Channeling II[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_SUMMON_BALOR]Summon Balor[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_ENTROPY3]Entropy III[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_ENTROPY]Entropy Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING3]Channeling III[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_DEFILE]Defile[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_ENTROPY]Entropy Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING4]Channeling IV[\\LINK][PARAGRAPH:2]The more sources of this Mana you control, the more likely your [LINK=UNITCOMBAT_ADEPT]Arcane units[\\LINK] are to be gifted with [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_ENTROPY]Affinity for this sphere[\\LINK]. That not only increases the unit's strength based on how much mana you control, but lets it learn more powerful versions of the spells in this sphere for free, without spending any xp to level up, so long as it has the proper Channeling promotions. [PARAGRAPH][LINK=PROMOTION_UNHOLY_TAINT]Unholy Taint[\\LINK] allows arcane units to learn Entropy Affinity through experience. [PARAGRAPH]This resource causes a diplomatic penalty with many leaders, and a bonus with those who wish to destroy the world. [PARAGRAPH]The effective supply of Entropy Mana is greater for the [LINK=CIVILIZATION_INFERNAL]Infernal[\\LINK] civilization. It is increased for those following [LINK=RELIGION_THE_ASHEN_VEIL]The Ashen Veil[\\LINK], and decreased for those following [LINK=RELIGION_HOUSE_OF_PLENTY]The House of Plenty[\\LINK],, either as a State Religion or as the caster's personal faith. [PARAGRAPH:2]Entropy was originally the sphere of Hope, but Agares hoped for the impossible and turned his sphere into Despair. He is now the leader of the evil gods, and seeks to ruin Erebus out of spite just as he ruined his won world of Nyx. This sphere focuses on the unmaking, ruin and destruction of objects, people, and society, not by overwhelming power, but by finding and intensifying the targets' inherent flaws. This power often works unintentionally. Flowers wither, clothes unravel, and food spoils just because a practitioner is around. Users are often unable to maintain relationships; they see the flaws in others to closely. They become solitary and depressed, often suicidal.
chinese: [TAB]开放衰退领域法术：[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_RUST]锈蚀[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_ENTROPY1]衰退 I[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_ENTROPY]衰退亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING1]引导 I[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_WITHER]枯萎[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_ENTROPY2]衰退 II[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_ENTROPY]衰退亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING2]引导 II[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_SUMMON_BALOR]召唤巨角炎魔[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_ENTROPY3]衰退 III[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_ENTROPY]衰退亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING3]引导 III[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_DEFILE]亵渎[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_ENTROPY]衰退亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING4]引导 IV[\\LINK][PARAGRAPH:2]你所控制的此种能量来源越多，你的 [LINK=UNITCOMBAT_ADEPT]秘法单位[\\LINK] 获赠 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_ENTROPY]对该领域的亲和[\\LINK]的几率就越高。此亲和不仅会依据你控制的能量多寡提升该单位的力量，还能让它免费习得该领域更强大的法术版本，无需花费经验值升级——只要它具备相应的引导晋升即可。 [PARAGRAPH][LINK=PROMOTION_UNHOLY_TAINT]邪秽污染[\\LINK] 能让秘法单位通过经验习得衰退亲和。 [PARAGRAPH]此资源会招致许多领袖的外交恶感，却会赢得那些意欲毁灭世界者的外交好感。 [PARAGRAPH]衰退能量的有效供给，对 [LINK=CIVILIZATION_INFERNAL]地狱军团[\\LINK] 文明。对跟随 [LINK=RELIGION_THE_ASHEN_VEIL]灰烬之幕[\\LINK]者增加，而对跟随 [LINK=RELIGION_HOUSE_OF_PLENTY]丰饶之家[\\LINK]（无论作为国教还是施法者个人信仰）者则减少。 [PARAGRAPH:2]衰退原本是希望的领域，但阿加雷斯所盼者乃是不可能之事，遂将他的领域化为绝望。他如今是邪神之首，一心要出于怨恨毁灭埃瑞布斯，正如他曾毁灭自己的世界尼克斯一般。这一领域专注于对物件、人与社会的解体、败坏与摧毁——并非凭借压倒性的力量，而是借由寻出并放大目标固有的缺陷。这种力量常在无意间发作：仅因修习者在场，花便凋谢，衣便脱线，食物便腐坏。使用者往往无法维系任何关系；他们把他人的缺点看得太过分明。他们变得孤僻而抑郁，常有轻生之念。

That not only increases the unit's strength based on how much mana you control, but lets it learn more powerful versions of the spells in this sphere for free, without spending any xp to level up, so long as it has the proper Channeling promotions. [PARAGRAPH]The effective supply of Fire Mana is greater for the [LINK=CIVILIZATION_CLAN_OF_EMBERS]Clan of Embers[\\LINK] civilization. It is reduced for those following [LINK=RELIGION_OCTOPUS_OVERLORDS]The Undertow[\\LINK], either as a State Religion or as the caster's personal faith. [PARAGRAPH:2]Fire is the element of passion, of acting out uncontrollably based on emotion and of rapid change. It was once a holy precept, a great righteous indignation that empowered men to purge evils from the world. At the end of the Age of Magic, the Goddess Bhall was corrupted. She fell from her heaven, and tore it asunder as she plummeted into the deepest hell. (Her archangel [LINK=UNIT_BRIGIT]Brigit[\\LINK] refused to be corrupted and continues to embody her element as it once was, but she was locked away in the [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_RING_OF_CARCER]Ring of Carcer[\\LINK]. ) Now that she has reawakened, her fury has turned against the good. Fire is wild and hungry, easy to use but difficult to control. [PARAGRAPH]The power to channel and control fire also applies to rapid change and mutation. There is often great power in these transformations, but they are temporary and often leave the target weaker or even destroyed by the experience. Practitioners that internalize their power often consume an external source to feed it (fire, hatred or physical matter that they reduce to ash) so that they aren't destroyed by it. Practitioners of this dominion are very passionate lovers and artist, or are very violent. They are often very driven individuals, obsessively pursuing their goals and looking to launch rebellions among the disenfranchised.
chinese: [TAB]开放炎之领域法术：[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_BLAZE]烈焰[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_FIRE1]炎之 I[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_FIRE]炎之亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING1]引导 I[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_FIREBALL]火球术[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_FIRE2]炎之 II[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_FIRE]炎之亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING2]引导 II[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_SUMMON_FIRE_ELEMENTAL]召唤火元素[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_FIRE3]炎之 III[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_FIRE]炎之亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING3]引导 III[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_PILLAR_OF_FIRE]火柱[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_FIRE]炎之亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING4]引导 IV[\\LINK][PARAGRAPH:2]你所控制的此种能量来源越多，你的 [LINK=UNITCOMBAT_ADEPT]秘法单位[\\LINK] 获赠 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_FIRE]对该领域的亲和[\\LINK]的几率就越高。此亲和不仅会依据你控制的能量多寡提升该单位的力量，还能让它免费习得该领域更强大的法术版本，无需花费经验值升级——只要它具备相应的引导晋升即可。 [PARAGRAPH]炎之能量的有效供给，对 [LINK=CIVILIZATION_CLAN_OF_EMBERS]余灰部落[\\LINK] 文明。而对跟随 [LINK=RELIGION_OCTOPUS_OVERLORDS]暗流[\\LINK]（无论作为国教还是施法者个人信仰）者而言则增加。 [PARAGRAPH:2]炎是激情的元素，是凭情绪失控而行、是迅疾变化的元素。它曾是一条神圣法理，一种伟大的义愤，赋予人力量去涤除世间的邪恶。魔法纪元末期，女神巴尔被腐化。她自天堂坠落，坠入最深的地狱之际将天堂撕裂。（她的大天使 [LINK=UNIT_BRIGIT]女神布里吉特[\\LINK] 拒绝被腐化，至今仍以其元素本来的面貌加以体现，但她被囚禁于 [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_RING_OF_CARCER]卡瑟囚环[\\LINK]之中。）如今她已重新苏醒，怒火转而指向善良。炎是狂野而饥渴的，易于驱使，却难以驾驭。 [PARAGRAPH]引导并操控炎的力量，也适用于迅疾的变化与蜕变。这些变形之中往往蕴含巨大的力量，但它们是短暂的，常使目标因此变弱，甚至被这一经历所毁。将其力量内化的修习者，往往需要消耗某种外部来源（火、仇恨，或被其焚为灰烬的实体物质）来供养它，以免自身被它毁灭。这一支配的修习者要么是极其热烈的情人与艺术家，要么极其暴烈。他们往往是干劲十足之人，执迷地追逐自己的目标，并伺机在被剥夺权利者中掀起叛乱。

english: [TAB]Allows access to the Force sphere spells:[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_TEMPERANCE]Temperance[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_FORCE1]Force I[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_FORCE]Force Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING1]Channeling I[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_WALL_OF_STONE]Ring of Warding[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_FORCE2]Force II[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_FORCE]Force Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING2]Channeling II[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_SUMMON_RUNEWYN]Summon Runewyn[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_FORCE3]Force III[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_FORCE]Force Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING3]Channeling III[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_PURGE_MAGIC]Purge Magic[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_FORCE]Force Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING4]Channeling IV[\\LINK][PARAGRAPH:2]The more sources of this Mana you control, the more likely your [LINK=UNITCOMBAT_ADEPT]Arcane units[\\LINK] are to be gifted with [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_FORCE]Affinity for this sphere[\\LINK]. That not only increases the unit's strength based on how much mana you control, but lets it learn more powerful versions of the spells in this sphere for free, without spending any xp to level up, so long as it has the proper Channeling promotions. [PARAGRAPH]The effective supply of Force Mana is greater for the [LINK=CIVILIZATION_GRIGORI]Grigori[\\LINK] civilization. [PARAGRAPH:2]This resource causes a diplomatic bonus with many leaders, and a penalty with those who wish to destroy the world. [PARAGRAPH:2]Force is the power of the immutable. The power of authority and judgement. Magic is performed as "Decrees", the Decree of Eternal Vigilance compels someone to protect the target with their life. The Decree of Silence keeps someone from ever speaking about a subject and the Decree of Sanctity keeps the target from entering a specific location. Decrees can apply to people or inanimate objects. Powerful practitioners can have decrees that impact the entire world. A "wall of force" isn't a physical construct, it is a decree that nothing can pass the area that is applied to the entire world. Many practitioners of this dominion are mute. They tend to be open minded and thoughtful, but once they make a decision, they are slow to move off of it. [PARAGRAPH]Force is the sphere of Balance, Compromise, Consensus, Agreements, and Contracts. Force does not have an opposing sphere; its opposite is an excess in any direction. It is prone to "The Grey Fallacy," assuming that the proper course of action is to compromise between opposing positions even if one is clearly better than the other or even if the compromise is worse than both. When both alternatives are bad, it can have trouble seeing which one is worse. The moderation of this sphere is however better than any extreme in most circumstances. [PARAGRAPH]Dagda, the God of Force, does not support unilaterally imposing one's will on another; he is however just as harsh as Junil when it comes to making someone keep his word or go along with what an overwhelming majority has decided. Dagda is the god most responsible for creating the plane of Erebus and its inhabitants. When The One ordered his angels to create worlds in the image of Heaven, they all created world far too tainted by their own preferences. Dagda convinced them to work together, each angel pairing up with his opposite in order to create worlds of balance and contrast. Once everyone saw that these worlds were superior to any they could create alone, he convinced them all to collaborate and make Erebus together. This world so pleased The One that he declared their work finished and took back the power of ex nihilo creation. The gods still had enough power left for their greatest creation: Mankind, a race of beings who possessed the divine spark of the gods within forms that perfectly balance all 21 elements, allowing a level of free will which the angels could not imagine. [PARAGRAPH]The Godswar was sparked by the disagreement over what to do with [LINK=LEADER_OS-GABELLA]the first human[\\LINK], and escalated to the point that the survival of Humanity and even Erebus itself was threatened. [LINK=LEADER_CASSIEL]Cassiel[\\LINK], the archangel of Dagda, convinced his god to bring the neutral gods together and force the war to end. The Compact was his idea, but he could not accept the agreement. One he learned of The One, he had no respect for these petty gods whose idea of peace was continuing to wage their war through human pawns.

[PARAGRAPH:2]此资源会赢得许多领袖的外交好感，却招致那些意欲毁灭世界者的外交恶感。 [PARAGRAPH:2]力场是不可动摇之物的力量，是权威与裁决的力量。其魔法以“敕令”的形式施行：永恒警戒的敕令迫使某人以性命护卫目标；缄默的敕令使某人永不能谈及某一话题；圣域的敕令使目标无法进入某一特定地点。敕令可作用于人，亦可作用于无生命之物。强大的修习者可拥有影响整个世界的敕令。所谓“力场之墙”并非有形的构造物，而是一道敕令：施加于整个世界，令任何东西都无法穿过那片区域。这一支配的许多修习者是哑者。他们往往心胸开阔、深思熟虑，可一旦做出决定，便迟迟不肯改变。 [PARAGRAPH]力场是平衡、妥协、共识、协议与契约的领域。力场没有对立的领域；与它相对的，是朝任一方向的过度。它易犯“灰色谬误”——认定正确的做法总是在对立立场之间折中，哪怕其中一方明显更优，哪怕折中比两者都糟。当两个选项皆恶时，它可能难以看清哪一个更坏。然而在多数情形下，这一领域的中庸都胜过任何极端。 [PARAGRAPH]力场之神达格达并不赞同将一己意志单方面强加于人；然而在迫使某人信守诺言、或服从绝大多数人的决定这一点上，他与朱尼尔一样严苛。达格达是缔造埃瑞布斯位面及其居民的最主要之神。当太一命他的天使们照天堂的样子创造世界时，他们所造的世界都被各自的偏好玷污得太深。达格达说服他们通力合作，每位天使与其对立者结对，以创造出平衡而对照的世界。当众神都看到这些世界优于任何独力所能创造者时，他又说服他们全体协作，共同缔造了埃瑞布斯。这个世界如此令太一欣悦，以至他宣布他们的工作已成，并收回了无中生有的创造之力。诸神仍余有足够的力量，去完成他们最伟大的造物：人类——一个在其形体之内蕴有诸神神圣火花的种族，其形体完美平衡了全部二十一种元素，赋予他们天使无法想象的自由意志。 [PARAGRAPH]诸神之战因如何处置 [LINK=LEADER_OS-GABELLA]第一个人类[\\LINK]的分歧而爆发，并升级到人类乃至埃瑞布斯本身的存续都受到威胁的地步。 [LINK=LEADER_CASSIEL]卡西尔[\\LINK]——达格达的大天使——说服他的神召集中立诸神，强行结束战争。盟约本是他的主意，可他自己却无法接受这份协议。当他得知太一之后，便再不敬重这些渺小的神祇——他们所谓的和平，不过是继续借人类为棋子来打他们的战争。

english: [TAB]Allows access to the Ice sphere spells:[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_SLOW]Slow[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_ICE1]Ice I[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_ICE]Ice Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING1]Channeling I[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_SUMMON_ICE_ELEMENTAL]Summon Ice Elemental[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_ICE2]Ice II[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_ICE]Ice Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING2]Channeling II[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_SNOWFALL]Snowfall[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_ICE3]Ice III[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_ICE]Ice Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING3]Channeling III[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_STAGNATION]Stagnation[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_ICE]Ice Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING4]Channeling IV[\\LINK][PARAGRAPH:2]The more sources of this Mana you control, the more likely your [LINK=UNITCOMBAT_ADEPT]Arcane units[\\LINK] are to be gifted with [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_ICE]Affinity for this sphere[\\LINK]. That not only increases the unit's strength based on how much mana you control, but lets it learn more powerful versions of the spells in this sphere for free, without spending any xp to level up, so long as it has the proper Channeling promotions. [PARAGRAPH]A Pact with Winter grants Ice Affinity to units with [LINK=PROMOTION_UNHOLY_TAINT]Unholy Taint[\\LINK], as well as [LINK=RELIGION_WHITE_HAND]White Hand[\\LINK] clerics. [PARAGRAPH]The effective supply of Ice Mana is greater for the [LINK=CIVILIZATION_ILLIANS]Illian[\\LINK] civilization. It is increased for those following [LINK=RELIGION_WHITE_HAND]The White Hand[\\LINK] and reduced for those following The [LINK=RELIGION_FELLOWSHIP_OF_LEAVES]The Fellowship of the Leaves[\\LINK], either as a State Religion or as the caster's personal faith. [PARAGRAPH:2]Ice is the force of stasis, of unchanging. It can also be a force for calm or slow recovery (like a coma). A little power can cause things to slow, and strong practitioners can cause natural processes to stop entirely. Practitioners become dogmatic, resistant to new ideas or reform. They love tradition and take comfort in rituals and habits. They tend to be conservative in all things. [PARAGRAPH]Ice is not merely conservative, but reactionary. It considers the past better then either the present or the future. It is nostalgia, a longing for the way we think things used to be (even if our memory is inaccurate). The One intended for this to complement the constant, gradual, progressive change of the sphere of Nature. When Mulcarn fell, it did not change much. He remained far less evil than the other evil gods. Since Sucellus stayed out of the war, he became the enemy of the rapid change of Bhall. During the Age of Magic, the forces of Bhall became so powerful that Mulcarn was nearly powerless. When he saw the advancements of that age, and how all gods but himself had come to be widely worshiped, he wished that mankind would return to how they lived during the Godswar. When Agares finally corrupted Bhall, he saw a chance. Unopposed, he was able to break The Compact and conquer Erebus itself. He defeated Sucellus when he came to stop him, but eventually fell to the Godslayer. In the Age of Rebirth, the Precept of Winter itself longs to return to the time when a god controlled it. The Illians long to return to their golden age. [LINK=LEADER_AURIC]Auric Ulvin[\\LINK] intends to fulfill these desires and become the new [LINK=UNIT_AURIC_ASCENDED]God of Winter[\\LINK].

It is increased for those following [LINK=RELIGION_THE_ORDER]The Order[\\LINK],and decreased for those following [LINK=RELIGION_SONS_OF_DISCORD]The Sons of Discord[\\LINK], either as a State Religion or as the caster's personal faith. [PARAGRAPH:2]This dominion is the power of justice and equity. It punishes inequity, corruption and randomness. Law frequently gives power equal to any just challenge, but no more. Practitioners tend to be obsessive compulsive in some aspect of their lives. They are reliable administrators but may be inflexible. Practitioners are the most powerful when standing against corruption. [PARAGRAPH:1]Law is the sphere of justice, but mostly the sphere of order. It values submission to authority and adherence to rules and regulations over freedom. Junil is the eldest of the Twenty One gods, and sees himself as their leader. He is extremely stern and unyielding. He cannot tolerate anyone breaking commandments. Despite this, he himself (like all the gods) broke The One's commandment when he agreed to make Man immortal, and again when he decided to use the power of the Gems of Creation against Agares rather than allowing his power to run out and become like a human himself. He also swore not to get involved in creation, before establishing a powerful religion for the purpose of countering the influence of demonic forces. The appearance of the Luonnotar has left him terrified that The One has returned and is not pleased with him.
chinese: [TAB]开放法则领域法术：[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_LOYALTY]忠诚[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_LAW1]法则 I[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_LAW]法则亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING1]引导 I[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_SUMMON_EINHERJAR]召唤英灵之军[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_LAW2]法则 II[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_LAW]法则亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING2]引导 II[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_UNYIELDING_ORDER]不屈秩序[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_LAW3]法则 III[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_LAW]法则亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING3]引导 III[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_COSMIC_ORDER]宇宙秩序[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_LAW]法则亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING4]引导 IV[\\LINK][PARAGRAPH:2]你所控制的此种能量来源越多，你的 [LINK=UNITCOMBAT_ADEPT]秘法单位[\\LINK] 获赠 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_LAW]对该领域的亲和[\\LINK]的几率就越高。此亲和不仅会依据你控制的能量多寡提升该单位的力量，还能让它免费习得该领域更强大的法术版本，无需花费经验值升级——只要它具备相应的引导晋升即可。 [PARAGRAPH]法则能量的有效供给，对 [LINK=CIVILIZATION_BANNOR]班诺尔[\\LINK] 文明。对跟随 [LINK=RELIGION_THE_ORDER]秩序圣教[\\LINK]者增加，而对跟随 [LINK=RELIGION_SONS_OF_DISCORD]纷争之子[\\LINK]（无论作为国教还是施法者个人信仰）者而言则增加。 [PARAGRAPH:2]这一支配是正义与公平的力量。它惩罚不公、腐败与无序。法则常赐予恰足以应对任何正当挑战的力量，却绝不逾此。修习者往往在生活的某一方面有强迫倾向。他们是可靠的管理者，却可能失于僵化。修习者在对抗腐败时最为强大。 [PARAGRAPH:1]法则是正义的领域，但更多是秩序的领域。它重视对权威的服从、对规章的恪守，甚于自由。朱尼尔是二十一位神中最年长者，自视为他们的首领。他极为严苛、绝不通融，无法容忍任何人违犯戒律。尽管如此，他自己（与所有神一样）也曾违背太一的戒律：一次是他同意使人类不朽，再一次是他决意动用创世宝石之力对抗阿加雷斯，而非任由自己的力量耗尽、沦为凡人。他还曾立誓不介入造物，随后却为对抗恶魔势力的影响而创立了一个强大的宗教。天母审判官的出现，令他惊惧太一已然归来，且对他不悦。

english: [TAB]Allows access to the Life sphere spells:[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_SANCTIFY]Sanctify[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_LIFE1]Life I[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_LIFE]Life Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING1]Channeling I[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_FERTILITY]Fertility[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_LIFE2]Life II[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_LIFE]Life Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING2]Channeling II[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_RESURRECTION_GRAVEYARD]Resurrection[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_LIFE3]Life III[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_LIFE]Life Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING3]Channeling III[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_GRANT_IMMORTALITY]Grant Immortality[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_LIFE]Life Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING4]Channeling IV[\\LINK][PARAGRAPH:2]The more sources of this Mana you control, the more likely your [LINK=UNITCOMBAT_ADEPT]Arcane units[\\LINK] are to be gifted with [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_LIFE]Affinity for this sphere[\\LINK]. That not only increases the unit's strength based on how much mana you control, but lets it learn more powerful versions of the spells in this sphere for free, without spending any xp to level up, so long as it has the proper Channeling promotions. [PARAGRAPH]The effective supply of Life Mana is greater for the [LINK=CIVILIZATION_MERCURIANS]Mercurian[\\LINK] civilization. [PARAGRAPH:2]Minor practitioners can influence fertility and help speed healing. More powerful can perform miraculous healing or extend life. Practitioners can also sense back through generations of a subject, sensing who assessors are, and bringing out their assets in their descendant. Practitioners are often conceived without sex. Those conceived like this often have high affinity. Practitioners are often drawn to those that are suffering, though they are often sought by powerful men as a balm against disease and old age. [PARAGRAPH:2]Life is the sphere of Perseverance and Self-Sacrifice. It is about risking all you have in order to achieve a greater goal. It is also about healing, about coming back after what seemed like defeat. [PARAGRAPH]The first God of Life was Nemed, but he sacrificed his precept in order to become the progenitor of the human race. He gave his godhood to Arawn, who embodied both Life and Death for three whole ages but always favored his original sphere. Arawn created twin archangels, one for each precept. Arawn stayed out of the Godswar (except to tend the souls of its many mortal casualties), but The Archangel of Life was always eager to fight. Basium frequently begged to be made God of Life himself so he could wage his war better, but Arawn always refused. Basium would not give up the fight even when ordered to do so by all the gods, but instead chose to fall and become a mortal as far as The Compact is concerned. At the end of the Age of Ice, Sucellus stole the Font of Life, leaving Arawn languishing as an almost powerless ghost so that he could resurrect himself as the new God of Life. Most men and gods view Sucellus as a champion of Good, but Basium hates him as much as the demons.
chinese: [TAB]开放生命领域法术：[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_SANCTIFY]净化[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_LIFE1]生命 I[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_LIFE]生命亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING1]引导 I[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_FERTILITY]丰饶[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_LIFE2]生命 II[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_LIFE]生命亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING2]引导 II[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_RESURRECTION_GRAVEYARD]复活[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_LIFE3]生命 III[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_LIFE]生命亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING3]引导 III[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_GRANT_IMMORTALITY]授予不朽[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_LIFE]生命亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING4]引导 IV[\\LINK][PARAGRAPH:2]你所控制的此种能量来源越多，你的 [LINK=UNITCOMBAT_ADEPT]秘法单位[\\LINK] 获赠 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_LIFE]对该领域的亲和[\\LINK]的几率就越高。此亲和不仅会依据你控制的能量多寡提升该单位的力量，还能让它免费习得该领域更强大的法术版本，无需花费经验值升级——只要它具备相应的引导晋升即可。 [PARAGRAPH]生命能量的有效供给，对 [LINK=CIVILIZATION_MERCURIANS]天界军团[\\LINK] 文明。 [PARAGRAPH:2]力量微弱的修习者能影响生育、加速愈合。更强者能施行奇迹般的治愈或延长寿命。修习者还能上溯感知一个对象数代的先祖，察知其祖辈为何人，并将其禀赋在其后代身上引发出来。修习者往往并非经由交合受孕。这般受孕者常有很高的亲和。修习者往往被受苦之人所吸引，却也常被有权势者求取，用作抵御疾病与衰老的良药。 [PARAGRAPH:2]生命是坚忍与自我牺牲的领域。它关乎为达成更宏大的目标而不惜押上你的一切。它也关乎治愈，关乎在看似败局之后卷土重来。 [PARAGRAPH]最初的生命之神是尼米德，但他为成为人类种族的始祖而牺牲了自己的法理。他将神格交予阿劳恩——阿劳恩整整三个纪元同时体现生与死，却始终偏爱他原本的领域。阿劳恩创造了一对孪生大天使，每条法理各一位。阿劳恩置身诸神之战之外（唯照拂战中众多凡人亡者的灵魂），但生命的大天使却始终渴战。巴希姆屡屡恳求自己被立为生命之神，好让他能更好地打他的战争，但阿劳恩总是拒绝。即便全体神明下令，巴希姆也不肯罢战，反而就盟约而言选择了堕落、化为凡人。冰之纪元末期，苏切鲁斯窃取了生命之泉，任由阿劳恩沦为几乎毫无力量的幽魂，好让自己复生为新的生命之神。多数人与神都视苏切鲁斯为善的斗士，但巴希姆对他的恨，不亚于对恶魔。

english: [TAB]Allows access to the Meta Magic sphere spells:[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_FLOATING_EYE]Floating Eye[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_METAMAGIC1]Meta Magic I[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_METAMAGIC]Meta Magic Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING1]Channeling I[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_DISPEL_MAGIC]Dispel Magic[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_METAMAGIC2]Meta Magic II[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_METAMAGIC]Meta Magic Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING2]Channeling II[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_SUMMON_DJINN]Summon Djinn[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_METAMAGIC3]Meta Magic III[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_METAMAGIC]Meta Magic Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING3]Channeling III[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_AWAKEN_MAGIC]Awaken Magic[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_METAMAGIC]Meta Magic Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING4]Channeling IV[\\LINK][PARAGRAPH:2]The more sources of this Mana you control, the more likely your [LINK=UNITCOMBAT_ADEPT]Arcane units[\\LINK] are to be gifted with [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_METAMAGIC]Affinity for this sphere[\\LINK]. That not only increases the unit's strength based on how much mana you control, but lets it learn more powerful versions of the spells in this sphere for free, without spending any xp to level up, so long as it has the proper Channeling promotions. [PARAGRAPH]The effective supply of Meta Magic Mana is greater for the [LINK=CIVILIZATION_AMURITES]Amurite[\\LINK] civilization. [PARAGRAPH:2]Meta Magic is the sphere of Knowledge and Memory It is focused on having an accurate understanding of the past. The One intended for this sphere to compliment Mind, which once dealt with predicting the future and now deals with trying to control it. Oghma's vault is home to a great library where secrets are kept that even the gods do not know. Mammon has invaded his vault trying to uncover these secrets. He conquered significant portions of it and convinced many of his angels to defect, before the God of Knowledge responded by filling the world with a mist that erases memories. Most of Mammon's troops have completely forgotten who they are and why they are there. [PARAGRAPH:2]This dominion focuses on the nature of magic itself. It is most commonly used to detect and identify magic. Though at moderate levels it can be used to break and disrupt spells and at the highest levels it can be used to transform magic, or the way it works. A master in this dominion can create an area where magic doesn't work, move an enchantment from one object to another, or trap a magical creature in an object. This dominion has to be accessed through symbols, runes and ritual. Practitioners spend long hours studying to understand these complex interactions much as a chemist studies chemistry. This makes for bookish, arcane sorts. Unusually there are varied types of this dominion that seem to have little connection to each other. One may understand magical interactions through precise mathematical drawings, another through colorful mandala, other through carvings on elaborate 3 dimensional objects. These all have the same result, but students of each have little to learn from each other. It appears that any way it is envisioned it is only an interpretation for the true nature of magic, and practitioners can only hope to learn by continuing to learn more about their particular interpretation. Learning another is like starting over.
chinese: [TAB]开放超魔领域法术：[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_FLOATING_EYE]飘浮之眼[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_METAMAGIC1]超魔 I[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_METAMAGIC]超魔亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING1]引导 I[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_DISPEL_MAGIC]驱散魔法[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_METAMAGIC2]超魔 II[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_METAMAGIC]超魔亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING2]引导 II[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_SUMMON_DJINN]召唤灯神[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_METAMAGIC3]超魔 III[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_METAMAGIC]超魔亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING3]引导 III[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_AWAKEN_MAGIC]唤醒魔法[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_METAMAGIC]超魔亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING4]引导 IV[\\LINK][PARAGRAPH:2]你所控制的此种能量来源越多，你的 [LINK=UNITCOMBAT_ADEPT]秘法单位[\\LINK] 获赠 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_METAMAGIC]对该领域的亲和[\\LINK]的几率就越高。此亲和不仅会依据你控制的能量多寡提升该单位的力量，还能让它免费习得该领域更强大的法术版本，无需花费经验值升级——只要它具备相应的引导晋升即可。 [PARAGRAPH]超魔能量的有效供给，对 [LINK=CIVILIZATION_AMURITES]阿姆莱特[\\LINK] 文明。 [PARAGRAPH:2]超魔是知识与记忆的领域。它专注于对过去获得准确的理解。太一本意是让这一领域去补足精神——精神一度掌管预测未来，如今却掌管试图操控未来。奥格玛的宝库中藏有一座宏大的图书馆，保存着连诸神都不知晓的秘密。玛门入侵了他的宝库，企图揭开这些秘密。他攻占了其中相当大的部分，并说服了玛门自己的许多天使叛投，随后知识之神以一场抹除记忆的迷雾笼罩世界作为回应。玛门的大多数兵卒已彻底忘却自己是谁、又为何身处此地。 [PARAGRAPH:2]这一支配专注于魔法本身的性质。它最常用于探测与识别魔法。不过在中等层次上，它可用于打破与扰乱法术；在最高层次上，它可用于转化魔法或改变魔法运作的方式。此支配的大师能创造出一片魔法失效的区域，能将某件魔法从一个物件移至另一个物件，或将一只魔法生物困于某物之中。这一支配须借符号、符文与仪式方能施行。修习者要花长时间钻研，以理解这些繁复的相互作用，一如化学家研究化学。这造就了一批书卷气十足、深奥孤僻之人。异乎寻常的是，这一支配存在多种彼此似乎毫无关联的门类。有人通过精确的数学图形来理解魔法的相互作用，有人通过绚丽的曼陀罗，有人则通过在繁复的立体物件上的雕刻。它们的结果相同，但各门的学徒彼此几乎无从借鉴。看来无论以何种方式设想，都只是对魔法真正性质的一种诠释，修习者只能寄望于不断深入钻研自己那一种诠释来精进。改学另一种，无异于从头再来。

english: [TAB]Allows access to the Mind sphere spells:[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_INSPIRATION]Inspiration[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_MIND1]Mind I[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_MIND]Mind Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING1]Channeling I[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_CHARM_PERSON]Charm[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_MIND2]Mind II[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_MIND]Mind Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING2]Channeling II[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_DOMINATION]Domination[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_MIND3]Mind III[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_MIND]Mind Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING3]Channeling III[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_HASTURS_RAZOR]Hastur's Razor[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_MIND]Mind Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING4]Channeling IV[\\LINK][PARAGRAPH:2]The more sources of this Mana you control, the more likely your [LINK=UNITCOMBAT_ADEPT]Arcane units[\\LINK] are to be gifted with [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_METAMAGIC]Affinity for this sphere[\\LINK]. That not only increases the unit's strength based on how much mana you control, but lets it learn more powerful versions of the spells in this sphere for free, without spending any xp to level up, so long as it has the proper Channeling promotions. [PARAGRAPH]The effective supply of Mind Mana is greater for the [LINK=CIVILIZATION_BALSERAPHS]Balseraph[\\LINK] civilization. [PARAGRAPH:2]Mind was the sphere of Foresight, meant to compliment the backwards looking sphere of Knowledge. Mammon foresaw a time when he could foresee no more, and feared his own death. He rebelled against The One in order to prevent this fate, which ended up making it come true. His desire to predict was replace by a desire to control. [PARAGRAPH]The power of memory and thought. Practitioners can read minds and protect their thoughts from the same. The more powerful can manipulate the memories of their targets or dominate them entirely. There are a wide range of effects that can be caused by this dominion, from becoming "invisible" by causing on target to fail to notice you, to implanting thoughts (you should go out on patrol), or mistaking the senses (that stick is a snake). The effects typically require concentration to maintain the effect. This dominion is largely ineffective against those whose minds are significantly different than the practitioners (so a human would be unable to affect animals or angels). [PARAGRAPH]Exposure to others minds often causes befuddlement or confusion in the practitioner. They are often unable to simply cause the change they want and will expose themselves to other thoughts or memories of their targets. Practitioners who use the power to frequently may begin to dream as if they were their target, or have odd memories from the lives of those they have influenced. Many go insane. Others suffer dementia where their memories become lost in sea of others.
chinese: [TAB]开放精神领域法术：[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_INSPIRATION]启迪[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_MIND1]精神 I[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_MIND]精神亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING1]引导 I[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_CHARM_PERSON]魅惑[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_MIND2]精神 II[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_MIND]精神亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING2]引导 II[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_DOMINATION]支配[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_MIND3]精神 III[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_MIND]精神亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING3]引导 III[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_HASTURS_RAZOR]哈斯塔之刃[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_MIND]精神亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING4]引导 IV[\\LINK][PARAGRAPH:2]你所控制的此种能量来源越多，你的 [LINK=UNITCOMBAT_ADEPT]秘法单位[\\LINK] 获赠 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_METAMAGIC]对该领域的亲和[\\LINK]的几率就越高。此亲和不仅会依据你控制的能量多寡提升该单位的力量，还能让它免费习得该领域更强大的法术版本，无需花费经验值升级——只要它具备相应的引导晋升即可。 [PARAGRAPH]精神能量的有效供给，对 [LINK=CIVILIZATION_BALSERAPHS]巴尔塞拉弗[\\LINK] 文明。 [PARAGRAPH:2]精神曾是预见的领域，本意是补足回望过去的知识领域。玛门预见到有朝一日他将再无所预见，遂惧怕自己的死亡。为规避这一命运，他反叛了太一，结果反倒使命运成真。他预测的欲望，被操控的欲望所取代。 [PARAGRAPH]记忆与思维的力量。修习者能读取心智，也能保护自己的思绪不被同样读取。更强者能操纵目标的记忆，或将其完全支配。这一支配可造成的效果范围极广：从让目标察觉不到你、从而变得“隐形”，到植入念头（你该去巡逻了），或使感官出错（那根木棍是条蛇）。这些效果通常需要专注方能维持。这一支配对那些心智与修习者大相径庭者大体无效（因此人类无法影响动物或天使）。 [PARAGRAPH]接触他人的心智，常使修习者陷入迷乱或困惑。他们往往无法径直造成自己想要的改变，而会让自己暴露于目标的其他思绪或记忆之中。过于频繁地使用此力量的修习者，可能开始如同自己就是目标那般做梦，或从自己影响过的人的生命中生出古怪的记忆。许多人因此发疯。另一些人则患上痴呆，记忆迷失在他人记忆的汪洋之中。

english: [TAB]Allows access to the Nature sphere spells:[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_POISONED_BLADE]Poison Blade[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_NATURE1]Nature I[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_NATURE]Nature Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING1]Channeling I[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_BLOOM]Bloom[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_NATURE2]Nature II[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_NATURE]Nature Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING2]Channeling II[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_SUMMON_TREANT]Summon Treant[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_NATURE3]Nature III[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_NATURE]Nature Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING3]Channeling III[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_OVERGROWTH]Overgrowth[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_NATURE]Nature Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING4]Channeling IV[\\LINK][PARAGRAPH:2]The more sources of this Mana you control, the more likely your [LINK=UNITCOMBAT_ADEPT]Arcane units[\\LINK] are to be gifted with [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_NATURE]Affinity for this sphere[\\LINK]. That not only increases the unit's strength based on how much mana you control, but lets it learn more powerful versions of the spells in this sphere for free, without spending any xp to level up, so long as it has the proper Channeling promotions. [PARAGRAPH]The effective supply of Nature Mana is greater for the [LINK=CIVILIZATION_LJOSALFAR]Ljosalfar[\\LINK] civilization. It is increased for those following [LINK=RELIGION_FELLOWSHIP_OF_LEAVES]The Fellowship of the Leaves[\\LINK] and reduced for those following [LINK=RELIGION_WHITE_HAND]The White Hand[\\LINK], either as a State Religion or as the caster's personal faith. [PARAGRAPH:2]Nature is the sphere of growth, maturation, and gradual, progressive change. It was created to balance the stasis of the sphere of Ice. Sucellus tried to stay out of the Godswar, entering it only near the end to rescue his archangel Cernunnos from Agares' hell. He then sided with Dagda and the other neutral gods to try to being the conflict to and end and force the signing of The Compact. Once Bhall fell and Mulcarn broke the compact, Sucellus was chosen to enter Erebus and stop stop him. He failed. His body was broken into seven pieces, and his spirit departed into the Netherworld like that of a mortal. He tended the soul of the dead for an age, until Mulcarn was destroyed by the Godslayer and his body was brought back together. He took over the sphere of Life and was resurrected, but did not think himself still able to embody Nature properly. As such, he entrusted Nature to Cernunnos. [PARAGRAPH]The power of the forest and the remote corners of the world can sense the life of a region and commune with plants and animals. Affinity is strongly based on the practitioners environment, being nearly powerless in urban areas and powerful in the deep forest. Practitioners often have a specific type of plant or animal that they bond with.
chinese: [TAB]开放自然领域法术：[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_POISONED_BLADE]淬毒之刃[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_NATURE1]自然 I[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_NATURE]自然亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING1]引导 I[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_BLOOM]绽放[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_NATURE2]自然 II[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_NATURE]自然亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING2]引导 II[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_SUMMON_TREANT]召唤树人[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_NATURE3]自然 III[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_NATURE]自然亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING3]引导 III[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_OVERGROWTH]疯长[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_NATURE]自然亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING4]引导 IV[\\LINK][PARAGRAPH:2]你所控制的此种能量来源越多，你的 [LINK=UNITCOMBAT_ADEPT]秘法单位[\\LINK] 获赠 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_NATURE]对该领域的亲和[\\LINK]的几率就越高。此亲和不仅会依据你控制的能量多寡提升该单位的力量，还能让它免费习得该领域更强大的法术版本，无需花费经验值升级——只要它具备相应的引导晋升即可。 [PARAGRAPH]自然能量的有效供给，对 [LINK=CIVILIZATION_LJOSALFAR]勒约沙尔法[\\LINK] 文明。对跟随 [LINK=RELIGION_FELLOWSHIP_OF_LEAVES]绿叶同盟[\\LINK] 者增加，而对跟随 [LINK=RELIGION_WHITE_HAND]白之手[\\LINK]（无论作为国教还是施法者个人信仰）者而言则增加。 [PARAGRAPH:2]自然是生长、成熟与渐进向前之变化的领域。它被创造出来，以平衡冰之领域的停滞。苏切鲁斯力图置身诸神之战之外，直到临近结束才介入，从阿加雷斯的地狱救出他的大天使科尔诺诺斯。此后他站到达格达与其他中立诸神一边，力图结束冲突、迫成盟约的签订。巴尔陨落、穆尔卡恩打破盟约之后，苏切鲁斯被选中进入埃瑞布斯去阻止他。他失败了。他的身躯被碎为七块，他的魂灵如凡人一般离去，去往冥界。他照拂亡者之灵历经一个纪元，直到穆尔卡恩被弑神者摧毁、他的身躯被重新聚合。他接掌了生命的领域并得以复生，却自认已无法再妥善地体现自然。于是，他将自然托付给了科尔诺诺斯。 [PARAGRAPH]森林与世界僻远角落的力量，能感知一方水土的生机，与草木鸟兽相通。亲和的强弱极大地取决于修习者所处的环境：在城市中几近无力，在幽深的森林里则强大。修习者往往有一种与之结缘的特定草木或走兽。

That not only increases the unit's strength based on how much mana you control, but lets it learn more powerful versions of the spells in this sphere for free, without spending any xp to level up, so long as it has the proper Channeling promotions. [PARAGRAPH]The effective supply of Shadow Mana is greater for the [LINK=CIVILIZATION_SVARTALFAR]Svartalfar[\\LINK] civilization. It is increased for those following [LINK=RELIGION_COUNCIL_OF_ESUS]The Council of Esus[\\LINK] and reduced for those following [LINK=RELIGION_THE_EMPYREAN]The Empyrean[\\LINK], either as a State Religion or as the caster's personal faith. [PARAGRAPH:2]Shadow was created to be he sphere of Trust. It allowed more intimate relationships by allowing individuals to confide in each other without fearing that their secrets would be shared with everyone else. Since the fall of Esus, it has come to represent Deception, the abuse and betrayal of trust. [PARAGRAPH]This is the power of deception, hiding and illusion. Unlike other dominions that give the power to detect their power, that is not granted through shadow. A practitioner can create illusions of size and complexity depending on his affinity. Many practitioners lose their affinity during the day. Nearly all practitioners have increased ability to see in darkness. Many with an affinity for this dominion see things that aren't real. Occasionally it is as strong as full hallucinations, but more commonly they are simply people moving in the shadows, something standing at the edge of the bed, or something glimpsed out of the corner of the eye that isn't really there.
chinese: [TAB]开放阴影领域法术：[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_BLUR]虚影[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_SHADOW1]阴影 I[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_SHADOW]阴影亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING1]引导 I[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_SHADOWWALK]暗影行走[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_SHADOW2]阴影 II[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_SHADOW]阴影亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING2]引导 II[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_SUMMON_MISTFORM]召唤雾影[\\LINK] ，需[LINK=PROMOTION_SHADOW3]阴影 III[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_SHADOW]阴影亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING3]引导 III[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_SUMMON_CHANGELING]替换为易形怪[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_SHADOW]阴影亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING4]引导 IV[\\LINK][PARAGRAPH:2]你所控制的此种能量来源越多，你的 [LINK=UNITCOMBAT_ADEPT]秘法单位[\\LINK] 获赠 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_SHADOW]对该领域的亲和[\\LINK]的几率就越高。此亲和不仅会依据你控制的能量多寡提升该单位的力量，还能让它免费习得该领域更强大的法术版本，无需花费经验值升级——只要它具备相应的引导晋升即可。 [PARAGRAPH]阴影能量的有效供给，对 [LINK=CIVILIZATION_SVARTALFAR]斯瓦塔尔法[\\LINK] 文明。对跟随 [LINK=RELIGION_COUNCIL_OF_ESUS]艾苏斯议会[\\LINK] 者增加，而对跟随 [LINK=RELIGION_THE_EMPYREAN]天空的教诲[\\LINK]（无论作为国教还是施法者个人信仰）者而言则增加。 [PARAGRAPH:2]阴影被创造之初，本是信任的领域。它让个体得以彼此倾诉，而不必担心秘密会被公之于众，从而促成更亲密的关系。但自艾苏斯堕落以来，它转而代表欺骗——对信任的滥用与背弃。 [PARAGRAPH]这是欺骗、隐匿与幻象的力量。与其他会赋予探测自身之力的支配不同，阴影并不给予这种能力。修习者能创造幻象，其大小与繁复程度取决于他的亲和。许多修习者在白昼会失去亲和。几乎所有修习者在黑暗中的视力都会增强。许多对这一支配有亲和者，会看见并不真实存在之物。偶尔强烈到形同彻底的幻觉，但更常见的，不过是阴影里晃动的人影、立在床边的某物，或眼角一瞥、其实并不存在的东西。

english: [TAB]Allows access to the Spirit sphere spells:[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_COURAGE]Courage[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_SPIRIT1]Spirit I[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_SPIRIT]Spirit Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING1]Channeling I[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_HOPE]Hope[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_SPIRIT2]Spirit II[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_SPIRIT]Spirit Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING2]Channeling II[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_ASSUAGE]Assuage[\\LINK] with[LINK=PROMOTION_SPIRIT3]Spirit III[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_SPIRIT]Spirit Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING3]Channeling III[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_PEACE]Peace[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_SPIRIT]Spirit Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING4]Channeling IV[\\LINK][PARAGRAPH:2]The more sources of this Mana you control, the more likely your [LINK=UNITCOMBAT_ADEPT]Arcane units[\\LINK] are to be gifted with [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_SPIRIT]Affinity for this sphere[\\LINK]. That not only increases the unit's strength based on how much mana you control, but lets it learn more powerful versions of the spells in this sphere for free, without spending any xp to level up, so long as it has the proper Channeling promotions. [PARAGRAPH]The effective supply of Shadow Mana is greater for the [LINK=CIVILIZATION_ELOHIM]Elohim[\\LINK] civilization. [PARAGRAPH][LINK=PROMOTION_UNHOLY_TAINT]Unholy Taint[\\LINK] may also grant units Spirit Affinity, if you have an Infernal Pact Lethe. [PARAGRAPH:2]Spirit is the sphere of Compassion, Empathy, Altruism, and Mercy. It embodies the Fruits of the Spirit. It is called the sphere of Wisdom, but the world often sees the wisdom of this sphere as foolishness. Most of the gods see Sirona like a nice little sister whose opinions do not really matter. Sirona was a close friend of Agares before his fall. The fall hurt her greatly, but she refuses to believe that evil the most evil of the gods is beyond redemption. Sirona forgives the wicked before they repent, in the hope that this forgiveness will lead them to repentance. She is the most clearly Good of the gods, but her sphere can be used for evil as well. Laroth was a master at using Spirit magic to read and manipulate the emotions of others. He tricked them into performing acts of self sacrificing and mutilating themselves to serve his purposes instead of their own good. [PARAGRAPH]This is the power of emotion, of hope and fear, of compassion and anger. It is the power that reminds us that our bodies are a thin veil for the soul that lies within us. Bodies that will break down when we experience true loss, and unable to stand under overwhelming grief. [PARAGRAPH]Twins are more likely to be gifted in this dominion. Blindness increases a practitioners affinity so it is more common in this dominion. Some practitioners blind themselves on purpose for this reason. Practitioners often unintentionally affect the emotions of those around them, because of that, they make good performers. Some practitioners have more powerful impact over those they love, some have more impact over those they hate.
chinese: [TAB]开放心灵领域法术：[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_COURAGE]勇气[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_SPIRIT1]心灵 I[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_SPIRIT]心灵亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING1]引导 I[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_HOPE]希望[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_SPIRIT2]心灵 II[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_SPIRIT]心灵亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING2]引导 II[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_ASSUAGE]抚慰[\\LINK] ，需[LINK=PROMOTION_SPIRIT3]心灵 III[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_SPIRIT]心灵亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING3]引导 III[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_PEACE]和平[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_SPIRIT]心灵亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING4]引导 IV[\\LINK][PARAGRAPH:2]你所控制的此种能量来源越多，你的 [LINK=UNITCOMBAT_ADEPT]秘法单位[\\LINK] 获赠 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_SPIRIT]对该领域的亲和[\\LINK]的几率就越高。此亲和不仅会依据你控制的能量多寡提升该单位的力量，还能让它免费习得该领域更强大的法术版本，无需花费经验值升级——只要它具备相应的引导晋升即可。 [PARAGRAPH]阴影能量的有效供给，对 [LINK=CIVILIZATION_ELOHIM]埃洛希姆[\\LINK] 文明。 [PARAGRAPH][LINK=PROMOTION_UNHOLY_TAINT]邪秽污染[\\LINK] 也可能赋予单位心灵亲和——前提是你拥有与莱丝缔结的地狱契约。 [PARAGRAPH:2]心灵是慈悲、共情、利他与怜悯的领域。它体现着心灵的果实。它被称作智慧的领域，但世人常将这一领域的智慧视为愚昧。多数神都把希罗娜看作一个可爱的小妹妹，觉得她的意见无足轻重。希罗娜在阿加雷斯堕落之前是他的密友。他的堕落令她深受伤害，但她拒绝相信这最邪恶的神已无可救赎。希罗娜在恶人悔改之前便宽恕他们，寄望这份宽恕能引他们悔改。她是诸神中最分明地属善者，但她的领域同样可被用于作恶。拉罗斯精于用心灵魔法读取并操纵他人的情感。他诱骗他人做出自我牺牲、乃至自残之举，去成全他的目的，而非他们自身的福祉。 [PARAGRAPH]这是情感的力量，是希望与恐惧、慈悲与愤怒的力量。它提醒我们：我们的肉体不过是内里灵魂的一层薄纱。当我们经历真正的失去时，这肉体会崩溃，会在铺天盖地的悲痛之下再也支撑不住。 [PARAGRAPH]双生子更容易在这一支配上得天赋。失明会增强修习者的亲和，故盲者在这一支配中更为常见。有些修习者为此故意弄瞎自己。修习者常在无意间左右周遭之人的情绪，正因如此，他们能成为出色的表演者。有的修习者对自己所爱之人影响更强，有的则对自己所恨之人影响更强。

english: [TAB]Allows access to the Sun sphere spells:[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_SCORCH]Scorch[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_SUN1]Sun I[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_SUN]Sun Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING1]Channeling I[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_BLINDING_LIGHT]Blinding Light[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_SUN2]Sun II[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_SUN]Sun Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING2]Channeling II[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_SUMMON_AUREALIS]Summon Aurealis[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_SUN3]Sun III[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_SUN]Sun Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING3]Channeling III[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_EPIPHANY]Epiphany[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_SUN]Sun Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING4]Channeling IV[\\LINK][PARAGRAPH:2]The more sources of this Mana you control, the more likely your [LINK=UNITCOMBAT_ADEPT]Arcane units[\\LINK] are to be gifted with [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_SUN]Affinity for this sphere[\\LINK]. That not only increases the unit's strength based on how much mana you control, but lets it learn more powerful versions of the spells in this sphere for free, without spending any xp to level up, so long as it has the proper Channeling promotions. [PARAGRAPH]The effective supply of Sun is greater for the [LINK=CIVILIZATION_MALAKIM]Malakim[\\LINK] civilization. It is increased for those following [LINK=RELIGION_THE_EMPYREAN]The Empyrean[\\LINK] and reduced for those following [LINK=RELIGION_COUNCIL_OF_ESUS]The Council of Esus[\\LINK], either as a State Religion or as the caster's personal faith. [PARAGRAPH:2]Sun is the sphere of Truth, Light, Revelation, Insight, Openness, and Honesty. It is benevolent, but often harsh. It shows its love through constructive criticism. Lugus is eager to forgive, but careful not to forgive those who have not yet truly repented. He does not forget past wrongs, but keeps a watchful eye out for any signs of sliding back into sin. The sphere of Light is the source of the human conscience. In psychopaths like Vampires who lack a conscience, the light of Lugus is experienced like physical pain and psychological panic. [PARAGRAPH]This is the power of revelation and spiritual truth. At modest levels it can destroy illusions and force the truth out of someone, and at the most powerful it can tear away everything false from a target, both physically and emotionally. [PARAGRAPH]It can strike those that refuse to see the truth blind, turn strong but insecure men into burnt reflections of their spiritual selves, and shock a rioting mob into seeing exactly what they have become. [PARAGRAPH]Telling lies weakens the power of a practitioner over this dominion. To the point that they can lose it entirely. Those that are completely open for years can reach amazing levels of power, but that is rare to find. Many casters are powerless at night, or when they are not in direct sunlight.
chinese: [TAB]开放太阳领域法术：[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_SCORCH]灼烧[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_SUN1]太阳 I[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_SUN]太阳亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING1]引导 I[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_BLINDING_LIGHT]致盲之光[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_SUN2]太阳 II[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_SUN]太阳亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING2]引导 II[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_SUMMON_AUREALIS]召唤烈焰巨人[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_SUN3]太阳 III[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_SUN]太阳亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING3]引导 III[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_EPIPHANY]顿悟[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_SUN]太阳亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING4]引导 IV[\\LINK][PARAGRAPH:2]你所控制的此种能量来源越多，你的 [LINK=UNITCOMBAT_ADEPT]秘法单位[\\LINK] 获赠 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_SUN]对该领域的亲和[\\LINK]的几率就越高。此亲和不仅会依据你控制的能量多寡提升该单位的力量，还能让它免费习得该领域更强大的法术版本，无需花费经验值升级——只要它具备相应的引导晋升即可。 [PARAGRAPH]太阳能量的有效供给，对 [LINK=CIVILIZATION_MALAKIM]马拉基姆[\\LINK] 文明。对跟随 [LINK=RELIGION_THE_EMPYREAN]天空的教诲[\\LINK] 者增加，而对跟随 [LINK=RELIGION_COUNCIL_OF_ESUS]艾苏斯议会[\\LINK]（无论作为国教还是施法者个人信仰）者而言则增加。 [PARAGRAPH:2]太阳是真理、光明、启示、洞察、坦荡与诚实的领域。它仁慈，却常严厉。它以建设性的批评来表达它的爱。卢古斯乐于宽恕，却谨防宽恕那些尚未真正悔改之人。他不忘旧过，而是警觉地留意任何重堕罪中的迹象。光明的领域是人类良知的源头。在吸血鬼这类缺乏良知的心理变态者身上，卢古斯之光会被体验为肉体的剧痛与心理的惊惶。 [PARAGRAPH]这是启示与灵性真理的力量。在适中的层次上，它能破除幻象、逼出某人口中的真相；在最强大的层次上，它能将目标身上一切虚假之物剥离殆尽——无论肉体上还是情感上。 [PARAGRAPH]它能使那些拒绝正视真相之人失明，能将强大却缺乏安全感之人化为其灵性自我的焦黑倒影，能震慑暴动的人群、令其看清自己究竟变成了什么。 [PARAGRAPH]说谎会削弱修习者对这一支配的掌控，直至可能将其彻底丧失。那些多年来完全坦荡之人能达到惊人的力量层次，但这样的人极为罕见。许多施法者在夜间、或不处于直射阳光之下时便毫无力量。

english: [TAB]Allows access to the Water sphere spells:[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_SPRING]Spring[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_WATER1]Water I[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_WATER]Water Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING1]Channeling I[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_WATER_WALKING_AFFINITY]Water Walking[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_WATER2]Water II[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_WATER]Water Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING2]Channeling II[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_SUMMON_WATER_ELEMENTAL]Summon Water Elemental[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_WATER3]Water III[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_WATER]Water Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING3]Channeling III[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_INUNDATION]Inundation[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_WATER]Water Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING4]Channeling IV[\\LINK][PARAGRAPH:2]The more sources of this Mana you control, the more likely your [LINK=UNITCOMBAT_ADEPT]Arcane units[\\LINK] are to be gifted with [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_WATER]Affinity for this sphere[\\LINK]. That not only increases the unit's strength based on how much mana you control, but lets it learn more powerful versions of the spells in this sphere for free, without spending any xp to level up, so long as it has the proper Channeling promotions. [PARAGRAPH]The effective supply of Water is greater for the [LINK=CIVILIZATION_LANUN]Lanun[\\LINK] civilization. It is increased for those following [LINK=RELIGION_OCTOPUS_OVERLORDS]The Undertow[\\LINK], either as a State Religion or as the caster's personal faith. [PARAGRAPH:2]Water is primarily about how one addresses emotions. Fire is impulsive, compelling one to act out irrationally as soon as an emotion is felt. Water is about calmly and rationally contemplating the emotions in order to better understand their cause before doing anything about them. It is an essential element of the wisdom of old age and the true intimacy and deep commitment of companionate love. It easily dismisses petty offenses, but may ruminate (particularly on issues related to one's loved ones) enough to lead to depression and withdrawal when it is not clear what can be done to make a situation better. Danalin, the God of Water, was among the least involved in the Godswar. He never went abroad to fight, but stayed at home with his beloved Aifons to protect them. He grieved when the Compact required him to depart from them, and grieved far more when a great calamity annihilated the race completely. That drove him into a depression so deep that we fell asleep and refuses to wake up. Hastur, the Archangel of Mammon and Lord of Nightmares, now whispers terror into his ears. The god is an effective dreamer, whose nightmares have given rise to the Undertow. PARAGRAPH]The force of the ocean is also the power of dreams, sleep and madness. Their power is strengthened with contact with water, but most are able to draw off of the moisture in the air and in their own bodies to cast. PARAGRAPH]In the Age of Rebirth, most practitioners struggle with horrific nightmares. The intensity increases with their affinity with this dominion. Ironically many gifted with affinity in this dominion are afraid of water, either that fear or an early trauma with water seems to have deepened their connection.
chinese: [TAB]开放水之领域法术：[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_SPRING]涌泉[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_WATER1]水之 I[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_WATER]水之亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING1]引导 I[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_WATER_WALKING_AFFINITY]水面行走[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_WATER2]水之 II[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_WATER]水之亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING2]引导 II[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_SUMMON_WATER_ELEMENTAL]召唤水元素[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_WATER3]水之 III[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_WATER]水之亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING3]引导 III[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_INUNDATION]淹没[\\LINK] ，需 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_WATER]水之亲和[\\LINK] 加 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING4]引导 IV[\\LINK][PARAGRAPH:2]你所控制的此种能量来源越多，你的 [LINK=UNITCOMBAT_ADEPT]秘法单位[\\LINK] 获赠 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_WATER]对该领域的亲和[\\LINK]的几率就越高。此亲和不仅会依据你控制的能量多寡提升该单位的力量，还能让它免费习得该领域更强大的法术版本，无需花费经验值升级——只要它具备相应的引导晋升即可。 [PARAGRAPH]水之能量的有效供给，对 [LINK=CIVILIZATION_LANUN]拉努恩[\\LINK] 文明。对跟随 [LINK=RELIGION_OCTOPUS_OVERLORDS]暗流[\\LINK]（无论作为国教还是施法者个人信仰）者而言则增加。 [PARAGRAPH:2]水首要关乎一个人如何对待情感。炎是冲动的，一旦感到某种情绪便驱人非理性地发作。水则关乎冷静而理智地审视情感，在采取任何行动之前，先更好地理解其缘由。它是老年智慧、以及伴侣之爱那真正的亲密与深沉承诺中不可或缺的要素。它轻易便将些许冒犯抛诸脑后，却也可能反复思量（尤其涉及所爱之人的事）到这般地步：当不知如何使境况好转时，便陷入抑郁与退缩。水之神达纳林是诸神之战中介入最少者之一。他从不远赴沙场，只留在家中守护他所钟爱的埃冯斯人。当盟约要求他离开他们时，他悲恸不已；当一场大灾将这个种族彻底湮灭时，他更是悲恸欲绝。这将他推入一场深不见底的抑郁，以至他沉睡不起、拒绝醒来。玛门的大天使、噩梦之主哈斯塔，如今在他耳边低语着恐怖。这位神是个有力的做梦者，他的噩梦催生了暗流。PARAGRAPH]大洋的伟力也是梦境、睡眠与疯狂的力量。它们的力量因接触水而增强，但多数施法者也能汲取空气中与自身体内的水汽来施法。PARAGRAPH]在重生的纪元里，多数修习者都在与恐怖的噩梦搏斗。噩梦的强烈程度随他们对这一支配的亲和而增。讽刺的是，许多在这一支配上得天赋者反倒惧水——要么是这份恐惧，要么是早年与水有关的创伤，似乎加深了他们与它的联系。

english: [TAB]The Guild of Endeavors is housed in a beautiful and ornate structure, built of stone and marble, and topped by a golden dome measuring over 100 feet in diameter. An extremely difficult engineering challenge, the dome has collapsed several times during its existence. Four graceful towers stand at the corners of the building. The interior of the building is a marvelous space of columns and arches extending up to the dome, which appears almost to float atop the building. The interior is sheathed in colored marble and golden mosaics depicting legendary scenes and images of kings.
chinese: [TAB]壮举公会坐落于一座华美而繁饰的建筑之中，以石料与大理石砌成，顶覆一座直径逾百英尺的金色穹顶。这穹顶是极为艰巨的工程难题，落成以来曾数度坍塌。四座优雅的塔楼矗立于建筑四角。建筑内部是由列柱与拱券构成的奇妙空间，一路向上延伸至那仿佛悬浮于楼顶的穹顶。内壁镶以彩色大理石与金色马赛克，描绘着传奇场景与历代君王的形象。

These raise the [ICON_CULTURE], [ICON_HAPPY], and Great Person Points for Artists in the city. english: Arawn is often called the Unhearing God, because he ignores all the prayers. of his worshipers in Creation, occupying himself with the matters of the afterworld instead. Despite this a small cult called The Eternal Cabal choose to worship him, though it is as useful as worshiping a rock. Occasionally the Archangel Gyra has intervened to help those who worship her god, although she is usually too busy battling the forces of Laroth. Many who believe they follow Arawn have actually been deceived into serving the Haunted, agents of Laroth who worship him as the new God of Death.
